harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server for the private network shared with node2/node3, and confirmed node2/node3 obtain their address on that network dynamically from node1 rather than any static assignment. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time with proof of changed boot identity and verified post-restart recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network state; discovered a second, unaddressed NIC on each (node1: eth1/enp8s0, node2: enp8s0, node3: enp8s0) forming the shared private segment, separate from the platform-DHCP-assigned default egress network

Confirmed node2/node3 systemd-networkd config (/etc/systemd/network/50-all-interfaces.network, Name=en*, DHCP=yes) already applies to enp8s0 with no static override present, satisfying 'obtain address via DHCP rather than static'

Configured VyOS node1 eth1 with static address 10.10.10.1/24 and a Kea-based DHCP server (service dhcp-server shared-network-name PRIVATE, subnet 10.10.10.0/24, pool 10.10.10.100-200, default-router/name-server 10.10.10.1), committed and saved to /config/config.boot
Verified isc-kea-dhcp4-server active on node1 and node2/node3 obtained dynamic leases (10.10.10.100/.101) on enp8s0, confirmed via kea logs, lease CSV, and 'dynamic' flag in ip addr on each client
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time) using native reboot mechanisms, polled each until exec was available again, and confirmed boot_id changed on each

Post-restart, verified node1's eth1 address, Kea DHCP service, and saved config persisted; verified node2 and node3 re-acquired dynamic DHCP leases from node1 on enp8s0 with correct hostnames in node1's lease table

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as DHCP server on the private network shared with node2/node3
evidence.summary: eth1/enp8s0 identified as the second, unaddressed NIC on all three nodes; VyOS DHCP (Kea) configured on node1 eth1 (10.10.10.1/24, pool 10.10.10.100-200), committed and confirmed active (isc-kea-dhcp4-server) handing out DHCPOFFER/DHCPACK to node2 and node3 MACs in the service logs

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 obtain their private-network address via DHCP from node1 rather than static assignment
evidence.summary: networkd config on node2/node3 matches en* with DHCP=yes and no static override; ip addr shows 'dynamic' addresses 10.10.10.101/10.10.10.100 on enp8s0; node1's Kea lease CSV records leases for both MACs, later updated with hostnames node2/node3

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node1: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 50503c5d captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-poll boot_id changed to 66058e73; eth1 address, Kea DHCP service, and full interface config confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node2: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 29011044 captured; reboot acknowledged; post-poll boot_id changed to 2bbf9a82; enp8s0 confirmed re-leased a dynamic DHCP address (10.10.10.100) from node1 after restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node3: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1e0cb179 captured; reboot acknowledged; post-poll boot_id changed to f09dde7c; enp8s0 confirmed re-leased a dynamic DHCP address (10.10.10.101) from node1 after restart

evidence.requirement: Final cross-check of overall DHCP service and cluster membership after all restarts
evidence.summary: isc-kea-dhcp4-server active post-restart; lease CSV shows current active leases for both node2 and node3 with correct hostnames, confirming end-to-end recovery of the DHCP relationship

attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server for the private network shared with node2/node3, and confirmed node2/node3 obtain their address on that network dynamically from node1 rather than any static assignment. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time with proof of changed boot identity and verified post-restart recovery.
